title_en: Lei Yuancheng v. Xiamen Wangjiang Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. and Far East Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — dispute over property ownership
ruling_gist_en: According to the provisions of relevant laws, regulations, and judicial interpretations, a legal person whose business license has been revoked shall undergo liquidation in accordance with the law, and its claims and debts shall be handled by the liquidation team. Where a legal person has not undergone liquidation in accordance with the law after its business license is revoked, creditors may apply to the people's court to designate relevant persons to form a liquidation team for liquidation. Where a legal person has not undergone liquidation in accordance with the law after the revocation of its business license, and creditors have not applied to the people's court to designate relevant persons to form a liquidation team for liquidation, but instead, during the litigation process, the legal person confesses or reaches a mediation agreement with the creditor to handle its claims and debts and dispose of its assets before liquidation, thereby harming the interests of other creditors, such conduct is inconsistent with the principle of equity and shall not be upheld by the people's court.

full_text_en:
Lei Yuancheng v. Xiamen Wangjiang Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. and Far East Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — dispute over property ownership

Ruling Summary

Pursuant to the provisions of relevant laws, regulations and judicial interpretations, after a legal person's business license is revoked, it shall undergo liquidation according to law, and its claims and debts shall be handled by the liquidation group. If a legal person fails to undergo liquidation according to law after its business license is revoked, creditors may apply to the People's Court to designate relevant persons to form a liquidation group for liquidation. If a legal person fails to undergo liquidation according to law after its business license is revoked, creditors also fail to apply to the People's Court to designate relevant persons to form a liquidation group for liquidation, but instead, during the litigation, through the legal person's admission or through a mediation agreement between the legal person and creditors, handle its claims and debts and dispose of the legal person's assets before liquidation, which harms the interests of other creditors, such actions are not consistent with the principle of fairness, and the People's Court will not sustain such actions.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

No. 29 (2006) Min Yi Zhong Zi

Appellant (plaintiff at first instance): Lei Yuancheng, male, born on April 29, 1962, resident of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, residing at G25, Winner Center, 333 Chai Wan Road, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

Agent ad litem: Lu Zhiyong, lawyer of Beijing Zhongkai Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Ma Jinyuan, lawyer of Beijing Zhongkai Law Firm.

Respondent (defendant at first instance): Xiamen Wangjiang Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at Haicang New Urban Area, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

Legal representative: Lei Yuansi, chairman of the board of the company.

Respondent (defendant at first instance): Far East Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at Rooms 1001-2, 10/F, Chinachem Tower, 34-37 Connaught Road Central, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

Legal representative: Zhang Qiongyue, chairman of the board of the company.

In the case of dispute over property ownership between appellant Lei Yuancheng and respondents Xiamen Wangjiang Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Wangjiang Company) and Far East Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Far East Real Estate Company), the Fujian High People's Court rendered a civil judgment on October 20, 2005, being (2005) Min Chu Zi No. 1. Lei Yuancheng, dissatisfied with the judgment, appealed to this Court. Upon acceptance, this Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and conducted an inquiry with relevant litigation participants in this case on July 17, 2006. Ma Jinyuan, agent ad litem of Lei Yuancheng, and Lei Yuansi, legal representative of Wangjiang Company, participated in the inquiry. Far East Real Estate Company, after being properly summoned, failed to appear in court without justifiable reasons. This case is now concluded.

The court of first instance found through trial: On April 16, 2004, Lei Yuancheng filed a lawsuit with the Fujian High People's Court, alleging that he and his elder brother Lei Yuansi established Far East Real Estate Development Company (hereinafter referred to as Real Estate Company) in Hong Kong in 1992, the nature of the company being an unlimited liability company. In March 1993, Lei Yuansi and Zhang Qiongyue established Far East Real Estate Company in Hong Kong. On November 22, 1993, Real Estate Company entered into a "Contract for Cooperative Construction and Operation of Wangjiang Garden New City" with Xiamen Haicang Construction Development Corporation (hereinafter referred to as Haicang Company), stipulating that Haicang Company would provide the construction land, and Real Estate Company would provide all development and construction funds, and the two parties would jointly construct and operate Wangjiang Garden New City (hereinafter referred to as Wangjiang Garden). By August 1994, the Wangjiang Garden project had completed the main structures of 13 buildings and the foundation works of 5 buildings. At the end of August 1994, Haicang Company withdrew from the cooperative project, and the Wangjiang Garden project was wholly owned by Real Estate Company. On October 12, 1994, Far East Real Estate Company established a wholly-owned subsidiary, Wangjiang Company, in Xiamen. Real Estate Company and Wangjiang Company agreed to place the Wangjiang Garden, for which the ownership registration of the houses and land use rights had not yet been completed, under the name of Wangjiang Company for operation. During the period of operation by Wangjiang Company, no large-scale investment was made in the Wangjiang Garden project, and the project has not been completed to date. Therefore, Wangjiang Company is merely the nominal owner of the Wangjiang Garden project. Wangjiang Company was deregistered by the Administration for Industry and Commerce in 1997, losing its capacity as a civil subject. Hence, Real Estate Company has the right to claim ownership of the assets of the Wangjiang Garden project placed under Wangjiang Company's name. Lei Yuansi has transferred all his shares in Real Estate Company and all his ownership interests in the Wangjiang Garden assets to Lei Yuancheng. Therefore, Lei Yuancheng sued Wangjiang Company and its shareholder Far East Real Estate Company, requesting confirmation that the ownership and land use rights of the Wangjiang Garden project under Wangjiang Company's name belong to him.

To support his claims, Lei Yuancheng provided the following evidence:

First group of evidence: 1. An "Agreement" between Haicang Company and Real Estate Company dated November 3, 1993, stipulating that Haicang Company would provide the plot with complete external supporting facilities, and Real Estate Company would provide the construction and installation costs, and both parties would jointly develop Plot 01-4 of the first phase residential area in Haicang New Urban Area; 2. A "Contract for Cooperative Construction and Operation of Wangjiang Garden New City" between Haicang Company and Real Estate Company dated November 22, 1993, reaffirming the content of the Agreement and naming the cooperative project as Wangjiang Garden; 3. An "Approval Reply on the Project Approval of Wangjiang Garden" issued by the Haicang Xinglin Taiwan Investment Zone Economic Development Bureau on January 6, 1994, approving Haicang Company to construct Xiamen Haicang Wangjiang Garden; 4. An "Agreement on Termination of Contract" between Haicang Company and Far East Real Estate Company dated August 31, 1994, stipulating the termination of the "Contract for Cooperative Construction and Operation of Wangjiang Garden New City" signed on November 22, 1993; 5. An "Agreement on Withdrawal of Investment from Wangjiang Garden" between Xiamen Anneng Economic Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Anneng Company) and Wangjiang Company dated December 25, 1997, stipulating the termination of the "Contract for Cooperative Development of Xiamen Haicang Wangjiang Garden" signed on January 20, 1994, Anneng Company's withdrawal of investment, and Wangjiang Company's repayment of Anneng Company's investment plus interest; 6. A civil mediation document from the Xinglin District People's Court of Xiamen City (2000) Xing Min Chu Zi No. 813. The above evidence is used to prove that all cooperative entities that had successively cooperated with Real Estate Company in developing the Wangjiang Garden project have withdrawn from the construction and operation of the Wangjiang Garden project, and Real Estate Company is the original investor and sole owner of the Wangjiang Garden project assets.

Second group of evidence: 1. An "Application Form for Project Construction Registration of Xiamen Haicang Investment Zone," indicating the construction unit of the Wangjiang Garden project as Real Estate Company; 2. A "Notice on Site Selection Planning Opinion" from the Xiamen Haicang Xinglin Taiwan Investment Zone Construction Bureau, indicating the construction unit of the Wangjiang Garden project as Haicang Company; 3. A "Construction Land Planning Permit" from the Xiamen Haicang Xinglin Taiwan Investment Zone Construction Bureau, indicating the construction units of the Wangjiang Garden project as Haicang Company and Real Estate Company; 4. "Records of Self-Review and Joint Review of Construction Drawings" for the Wangjiang Garden project, indicating Haicang Company and Real Estate Company as the units participating in the self-review and joint review of construction drawings; 5. "Inspection and Acceptance Records of Concealed Works" for the Wangjiang Garden project. The above evidence is used to prove that the actual investing and constructing unit of the Wangjiang Garden project was Real Estate Company.

Third group of evidence: 1. A civil judgment from the Quanzhou Intermediate People's Court (2001) Quan Min Chu Zi No. 04; 2. A civil judgment from the Fujian High People's Court (2003) Min Min Zhong Zi No. 98; 3. A "Contract for Contracting Responsibility System" between Nan'an County No. 4 Construction Engineering Company and Lei Yuansi; 4. An "Economic Contract" between Nan'an County No. 5 Construction Engineering Company, Nan'an County Jiudu Construction Engineering Company, and Lei Yuansi; 5. Some vouchers for investment in Wangjiang Garden in the name of No. 6 Construction Team of Nan'an County No. 4 Construction Engineering Company and No. 8 Engineering Team of Nan'an County No. 5 Construction Engineering Company; 6. Construction Bank wire transfer vouchers; 7. Payment vouchers from No. 8 Construction Team of Nan'an County No. 5 Construction Engineering Company. The above evidence is used to prove that Lei Yuansi invested a large amount of equipment, materials, and funds into the Wangjiang Garden project through construction teams personally managed by him—No. 6 Construction Team of Nan'an County No. 4 Construction Engineering Company and No. 8 Engineering Team of Nan'an County No. 5 Construction Engineering Company. The Wangjiang Garden project was invested and constructed by Lei Yuancheng and Lei Yuansi and should belong to Lei Yuancheng.

Fourth group of evidence: 1. An "Agreement on Offsetting Land Price with Project Funds" signed by Xiamen Haicang Xinglin Taiwan Investment Zone Management Committee, Armed Police Hydropower Troops Xiamen Headquarters, and Wangjiang Company on November 28, 1994; 2. A special receipt for administrative and institutional charges of Fujian Province (No. 0059645). The above evidence is used to prove that the 5 million yuan for purchasing the land use rights of the Wangjiang Garden project came from proceeds from the transfer of Wangjiang Garden properties, and the Wangjiang Garden properties were invested and constructed by Real Estate Company. Therefore, the land use rights of Wangjiang Garden were actually purchased with funds from Real Estate Company, not formed by investment from other entities.

Fifth group of evidence: 1. "Statement of Explanation" issued by Xiamen Branch of Xi'an Design and Research Institute of the Ministry of Coal Industry and Xiamen Anneng Construction Company on April 15, 2004; 2. A certificate issued by Xiamen Branch of Xi'an Design and Research Institute of the Ministry of Coal Industry on April 15, 2004; 3. "Mortar Construction Records" and "Mortar Test Block Compression Test Reports" for the Wangjiang Garden project; 4. "Concrete Construction Records" and "Concrete Test Block Compression Test Reports" for the Wangjiang Garden project; 5. "Inspection and Acceptance Records for Concealed Work of Steel Reinforcement" for the Wangjiang Garden project; 6. "Quality Ledgers" for the Wangjiang Garden project; 7. "Shift Handover Records" for the Wangjiang Garden project. The above evidence mutually corroborates that the Wangjiang Garden project was substantially completed by August 1994, when Wangjiang Company had not yet been established. Therefore, the Wangjiang Garden project was invested and constructed by Real Estate Company and should belong to Lei Yuancheng.

Sixth group of evidence: 1. "Court Order Made in Chambers of the High Court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Court of First Instance" in Miscellaneous Proceedings No. 4823 of 2001; 2. "Form for Cancellation of Foreign-invested Enterprises"; 3. "Announcement on Service of Administrative Punishment Decision to Revoke Business Licenses of 541 Foreign-invested Enterprises including Xiamen Tiandu Entertainment Co., Ltd." from Xiamen Administration for Industry and Commerce. The above evidence is used to prove that due to tortious acts of Zhang Qiongyue and others, the nominal owner of Wangjiang Garden assets, Wangjiang Company, had its business license revoked (cancelled), leaving the Wangjiang Garden assets in an ownerless state.

Seventh group of evidence: 1. "Approval Reply of Xiamen Municipal People's Government on the Use of Land for Commercial Housing Construction in Wangjiang Garden New City"; 2. Haicang 96039 "Construction Project Planning Permit"; 3. A letter from Wangjiang Company to the leaders of Xiamen Land and Housing Administration Bureau dated August 20, 1996. This group of evidence, combined with the first group, is used to prove that the Wangjiang Garden project was a project that, under specific circumstances and a specific time, was developed and constructed first, with relevant approval procedures later supplemented. The ownership procedures for the project were not completed even when the relevant assets were placed under the name of Wangjiang Company. Therefore, the ownership status of the Wangjiang Garden project assets should be determined comprehensively based on the overall facts of the case, that is, based on the actual circumstances such as the acquisition, design, investment, and construction of the project.

Wangjiang Company did not object to the evidence provided by Lei Yuancheng.

Wangjiang Company provided the following groups of evidence: 1. "Notice of Board Meeting" and notarization, proving that Wangjiang Company had notified company director Zhang Qiongyue of the litigation and held a board meeting for discussion; 2. "Declarations" of Zhou Yongli and Zhang Yuanwang and notarization, proving that director Zhang Qiongyue failed to attend the meeting as required by the "Notice of Board Meeting" and failed to hand over company documents, accounts, and company seal; 3. "Declaration" of Guo Shaoqun and "Certificate of Board Resolution" authorizing Guo Shaoqun to sign the said "Declaration", proving that all relevant operational materials of Wangjiang Company were in the possession and control of Zhang Qiongyue, and Wangjiang Company was unable to operate normally; 4. A report in Xiamen Evening News on November 16, 2000, titled "Wangjiang Garden without Water and Electricity for Three Years, Relevant Departments Trying to Coordinate Resolution", proving that due to Zhang Qiongyue's possession and control of Wangjiang Company's management materials and her abandonment of the company's management, the Wangjiang Garden assets were left unmanaged and arbitrarily encroached upon.

Lei Yuancheng did not object to the evidence provided by Wangjiang Company.

In its defense, Wangjiang Company admitted to all of Lei Yuancheng's claims, stating that given the current disorderly state of Wangjiang Garden, it was willing to have Wangjiang Garden adjudged to belong to Lei Yuancheng.

The court of first instance additionally found: 1. Real Estate Company was registered and established in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in August 1992, as an unlimited liability company, with shareholders being Lei Yuansi and Lei Yuancheng. The company did not conduct business registration after October 15, 1992. According to the relevant regulations of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Real Estate Company could not conduct business in its name without business registration.

2. On June 8, 2004, Lei Yuansi declared the transfer of all his shares in Real Estate Company to Lei Yuancheng, and on April 26, 2005, he issued another declaration transferring all his shares in Real Estate Company and all assets of Wangjiang Garden to Lei Yuancheng.

3. Wangjiang Company was a wholly-owned enterprise established by Far East Real Estate Company in October 1994 with investment. The company's business license was revoked in 2001, and it has not yet undergone liquidation.

4. On October 25, 1994, the Xiamen Haicang Xinglin Taiwan Investment Zone Construction Bureau entered into a "Contract for Paid Transfer of State-owned Land Use Rights in Xiamen Haicang Investment Zone" ([1994] Xia Cang Di He Zi [016]) with Wangjiang Company, transferring Plot 01-1C of Haicang New Zone, with an area of 37,371.32 square meters, to Wangjiang Company. Wangjiang Company obtained the state-owned land use rights certificate (Xia Guo Yong [96] Zi No. 255) on September 26, 1996, which records: address: Plot 01-C of Haicang New Zone, land area: 7,700.24 square meters, source of land rights: paid transfer land. On September 23, 1996, Wangjiang Company obtained the "Construction Project Planning Permit". On September 13, 1994, the Xiamen Haicang Xinglin Taiwan Investment Zone Construction Bureau issued a "Construction Land Planning Permit" to Far East Real Estate Company. The developer of the Wangjiang Garden (Phase I) project was also Wangjiang Company, with pre-sale permit number 950135.

The court of first instance held that the establishment and modification of real property rights in China are contingent upon registration. Wangjiang Company entered into a "Contract for Paid Transfer of State-owned Land Use Rights in Xiamen Haicang Investment Zone" with the Xiamen Haicang Xinglin Taiwan Investment Zone Construction Bureau and obtained the land use rights for Plot 01-C of Haicang New Zone and the ownership of the Wangjiang Garden (Phase I) project. Although Wangjiang Company's business license as a legal person has been revoked, since it has not undergone liquidation and cancellation, its legal person status has not been lost, and it remains the holder of the land use rights for Plot 01-C of Haicang New Zone and the owner of the Wangjiang Garden (Phase I) project. Even if Real Estate Company was the actual investor in the Wangjiang Garden project, since no ownership registration was conducted, it does not legally own the ownership and land use rights of the Wangjiang Garden project. Therefore, the evidence provided by Lei Yuancheng and Wangjiang Company is not relevant to Lei Yuancheng's claims and is not accepted. Additionally, during the litigation, although Lei Yuansi, the legal representative of Wangjiang Company, agreed to confirm the ownership and land use rights of the Wangjiang Garden project to Lei Yuancheng, according to Article 40 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the PRC, which provides that "When a legal person terminates, it shall undergo liquidation in accordance with the law and cease all activities outside the liquidation," Article 33 of the Regulations on the Administration of Enterprise Legal Person Registration of the PRC, which provides that "When an enterprise legal person's Business License for Enterprise Legal Person is revoked, its claims and debts shall be handled by the competent authority or the liquidation organization," and Article 10 of the Opinions on Several Issues concerning the Implementation of Enterprise Registration Administration issued by the State Administration for Industry and Commerce, which provides that "If a company's Business License for Enterprise Legal Person is revoked according to law, the shareholders shall organize a liquidation group for liquidation," in the case where an enterprise legal person's business license has been revoked, the enterprise's assets can only be disposed of through liquidation procedures. Therefore, the expression of intent of Lei Yuansi, the legal representative of Wangjiang Company, cannot serve as a reason to support Lei Yuancheng's claims. In summary, the rights and interests arising from Real Estate Company's actual investment in the Wangjiang Garden project, as claimed by Lei Yuancheng, should be resolved through liquidation procedures. Lei Yuancheng's claim to ownership and land use rights of the Wangjiang Garden project, on the grounds that Real Estate Company is the actual investor of the Wangjiang Garden project, that Wangjiang Company has made no capital contribution to the project and is merely the nominal owner of the project and holder of land use rights, and that Wangjiang Company has ceased operations, leaving the Wangjiang Garden project in an unmanaged state, lacks factual and legal basis and is not sustained. Pursuant to Article 40 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the PRC and Article 59 of the Urban Real Estate Administration Law of the PRC, the claim of Lei Yuancheng is dismissed. The case acceptance fee of RMB 170,010 shall be borne by Lei Yuancheng.

Lei Yuancheng, dissatisfied with the first instance judgment, appealed to this Court, requesting the revocation of the first instance judgment, confirmation that the ownership and land use rights of the Wangjiang Garden project under Wangjiang Company's name belong to Lei Yuancheng, and that the litigation costs be borne by Wangjiang Company and Far East Real Estate Company. The main reasons are:

1. The first instance judgment omitted trial and adjudication of Lei Yuancheng's claims, violating legal procedures. Lei Yuancheng's claim was for confirmation of the ownership of the properties and all land use rights of the Wangjiang Garden project. The first instance judgment only adjudicated on a small portion of the land use rights of the Wangjiang Garden project and did not address the ownership of the properties specifically claimed by Lei Yuancheng and the land use rights beyond the registered portion, which constitutes omission of trial and adjudication, violating legal procedures.

2. The facts found in the judgment of the first instance were erroneous. The formation, management, and registration of the Wang Jiang Garden real property had a special historical background, i.e., investment in and construction of the Wang Jiang Garden real property preceded the subsequent supplementation of planning permit procedures, construction permit procedures, and property rights registration procedures. The "Agreement" and "Contract for Cooperative Construction and Operation of Wang Jiang Garden New City" provided by Lei Yuancheng, which were signed between the Property Company and Haicang Company, proved that the original developer of the Wang Jiang Garden project was Lei Yuancheng and that the ownership of the project belonged to Lei Yuancheng. The "Xiamen Haicang Investment Zone Project Construction Registration Application Form" and the "Statement of Circumstances" from the Xiamen Branch of the Coal Industry Ministry Xi'an Design and Research Institute and Xiamen Anneng Construction Company, provided by Lei Yuancheng, proved that the actual construction entity of the Wang Jiang Garden project was Lei Yuancheng. The vouchers provided by Lei Yuancheng, regarding the investment in the Wang Jiang Garden project by the Fourth Construction Team of the Nan'an County Fourth Construction Engineering Company and the Eighth Construction Team of the Fifth Construction Engineering Company, which he contracted to manage, proved that the actual investor in the Wang Jiang Garden project was Lei Yuancheng. The above evidence also confirmed that the creation of the Wang Jiang Garden real property was special, namely, investment and construction came first, and procedures such as planning, construction, and registration were handled later. The evidence provided by Lei Yuancheng was authentic and lawful, directly related to his claims, and the directions of proof consistently pointed to the basic fact that Lei Yuancheng was the investor and builder of the Wang Jiang Garden project real property, demonstrating that Lei Yuancheng's claims had sufficient factual and legal basis. During the first instance proceedings, neither Wang Jiang Company nor Far East Real Estate Company adduced any evidence to rebut the evidence provided by Lei Yuancheng, nor did they raise any objections. Pursuant to Article 72 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Evidence in Civil Proceedings, the people's court should, in accordance with law, determine the probative force of the evidence adduced by Lei Yuancheng and confirm the basic fact that Lei Yuancheng was the investor and builder of the Wang Jiang Garden project real property. The first instance judgment did not examine the evidence adduced by Lei Yuancheng in accordance with the above provisions of the Supreme People's Court, and its determination that the evidence adduced by Lei Yuancheng was not related to his claims was erroneous.

3. The first instance judgment's order that Lei Yuancheng resolve the ownership of the Wang Jiang Garden project through liquidation proceedings lacked legal basis, and the judgment's guidance was completely unenforceable. The Property Company was a Hong Kong company. After the dissolution of Haicang Company, the original owner of the Wang Jiang Garden project, the Property Company could not obtain property rights registration in its own name. Therefore, only after the Wang Jiang Garden project real property had been formed was Wang Jiang Company established to take over and operate the said real property. After Wang Jiang Company took over the Wang Jiang Garden project, due to the infringing conduct of certain directors of the company, the company abandoned the management and operation of the Wang Jiang Garden project real property, its business qualification was also revoked, the Wang Jiang Garden real property was left without an owner, and relevant properties were arbitrarily occupied. Under these circumstances, neither Wang Jiang Company nor its nominal investor, Far East Real Estate Company, took any action to protect the Wang Jiang Garden properties, nor did they organize the liquidation of Wang Jiang Company. As Lei Yuancheng was not a shareholder of Wang Jiang Company, he could not organize the liquidation of Wang Jiang Company. Therefore, it was impossible for Lei Yuancheng to realize his related rights in the Wang Jiang Garden project real property through the path of liquidation.

Since Wang Jiang Company's business license had been revoked, it had lost its business qualification and was not entitled to engage in any further business activities. Therefore, it was also impossible for Lei Yuancheng to change the property rights registration of the Wang Jiang Garden real property by signing an agreement with that company; he could only recover the property by requesting the people's court to confirm his rights. Based on the above circumstances, Lei Yuancheng requested the people's court to confirm his ownership of the Wang Jiang Garden real property, so as to restore his management of the said real property.

Wang Jiang Company responded in court, agreeing with all of Lei Yuancheng's appellate arguments.

Far East Real Estate Company did not provide any defense submissions.

During the second instance, this court found that on August 31, 1994, Far East Real Estate Company and Haicang Company signed the "Agreement on Termination of Contract," stipulating that the parties would terminate the original Wang Jiang Garden cooperation contract signed between Haicang Company and Far East Real Estate Company, and that the termination would take effect upon the completion of the liquidation of debts and claims between the parties.

On January 20, 1994, the Property Company and Xiamen Anneng Company signed the "Contract for Cooperative Development of Haicang Wang Jiang Garden," stipulating that the Property Company would be responsible for the comprehensive development work of the Wang Jiang Garden project, including engineering construction, operation management, and housing sales, while Anneng Company would be responsible for providing the business license, qualification certificates, and other procedures required for construction, and for handling procedures such as the construction permit. The two parties would jointly develop the Wang Jiang Garden project. On December 25, 1997, Anneng Company and Wang Jiang Company signed the "Agreement on Withdrawal of Investment from Wang Jiang Garden," stipulating that Wang Jiang Company's investment amount of RMB 2,153,874 payable to Anneng Company would be offset by 1,794.90 square meters of property in Wang Jiang Garden. Subsequently, Wang Jiang Company did not deliver the property, and Anneng Company filed a lawsuit with the Xinglin District People's Court of Xiamen. The court issued Civil Mediation Letter No. (2000) Xing Min Chu Zi No. 813, determining that Wang Jiang Company should compensate Anneng Company principal and interest in the amount of RMB 1,150,000 before January 30, 2001.

The Xiamen Municipal Administration for Industry and Commerce issued Announcement No. (2001) 2, "Notice of Service of Administrative Penalty Decision on Revocation of Business Licenses of 541 Foreign-Invested Enterprises including Xiamen Tiandu Entertainment Co., Ltd.," stating that the revoked enterprises should surrender the original and duplicate copies of their business licenses and seals to the Administration for Industry and Commerce within three months, and their claims and debts should be liquidated by the company's shareholders.

In 1998, Lei Yuansi filed a lawsuit with the Fujian High People's Court against Zhang Qiongyue as defendant, requesting confirmation of Lei Yuansi's shareholder rights and interests in Xiamen Far East Company and Wang Jiang Company. The Fujian High People's Court rendered Civil Judgment No. (1998) Min Jing Chu Zi No. 04, which found that: on August 25, 1994, Far East Real Estate Company established the wholly foreign-owned enterprise Wang Jiang Company in Xiamen, with a registered capital of RMB 18 million, with Lei Yuansi as Chairman of the Board of Directors and Zhang Qiongyue as Vice Chairman. The company's business scope included engaging in real estate development and operation in the Haicang Investment Zone and self-managed property management. On November 22, 1994, Xiamen Zhongmin Certified Public Accountants, commissioned by Wang Jiang Company, verified the company's paid-in capital, proving that as of November 21, 1994, the company had actually received capital of RMB 14,180,380.35 from Far East Real Estate Company, accounting for 78.8% of the registered capital. On December 12, 1996, Xiamen Zhongzheng Auditing Firm, commissioned to verify Wang Jiang Company's paid-in capital, proved that the company's paid-in capital was USD 1,637,419.50, all of which was invested in cash by Zhang Qiongyue from within China using foreign exchange.

Lei Yuancheng stated during the first instance trial on August 31, 2005, that the Property Company, when developing real estate in Mainland China, had not anticipated that Haicang Company would withdraw from the cooperation. Subsequently, it was agreed with Far East Real Estate Company to establish a dedicated company in Mainland China to develop the Wang Jiang Garden project, but Lei Yuancheng was unwilling to join. The parties orally agreed that Lei Yuancheng would receive dividends after the development was completed.

The other facts found by this court are the same as those found by the court of first instance.

This court is of the opinion that there are two issues in focus for this second instance: first, whether the court of first instance comprehensively adjudicated Lei Yuancheng's claims; second, whether Lei Yuancheng is the owner of the real estate of the Wang Jiang Garden project under the name of Wang Jiang Company.

(I) Regarding the issue of whether the court of first instance comprehensively adjudicated Lei Yuancheng's claims. This case has established that Wang Jiang Company obtained the land use right certificate for the 7,700.24 square meter plot 01-C in Haicang New District and the pre-sale permit for commercial housing for the Wang Jiang Garden (Phase I) project. The acquisition of the above certificates indicates that the ownership of the Wang Jiang Garden (Phase I) project and the land use right for the 7,700.24 square meter plot 01-C in Haicang New District belong to Wang Jiang Company. The parties did not provide evidence during the proceedings to prove that Wang Jiang Company had completed the project establishment approval procedures for projects other than Wang Jiang Garden (Phase I). Pursuant to the "Regulations on the Development and Operation Management of Real Estate" of the PRC and other relevant legal provisions, projects for which Wang Jiang Company has not completed the approval procedures and land for which it has not obtained the use right are not assets under the name of Wang Jiang Company. Lei Yuancheng's lawsuit requested the people's court to confirm that the ownership of the Wang Jiang Garden project and the land use right under the name of Wang Jiang Company belong to him. This should be interpreted as a request to confirm the ownership of the Wang Jiang Garden (Phase I) project under the name of Wang Jiang Company and the land use right for the 7,700.24 square meter plot 01-C in Haicang New District. On the basis of finding the facts, the court of first instance made a determination on the owner of the Wang Jiang Garden (Phase I) project and the holder of the land use right for the 7,700.24 square meter plot 01-C in Haicang New District, thereby comprehensively adjudicating Lei Yuancheng's claims. Lei Yuancheng's argument that the court of first instance omitted or failed to adjudicate his claims is inconsistent with the facts, and this court does not support it.

(II) Regarding the issue of whether Lei Yuancheng is the owner of the real estate of the Wang Jiang Garden project under the name of Wang Jiang Company. Pursuant to the "Urban Real Estate Administration Law of the PRC," the certificate of real estate ownership is the legal document for determining the owner of real estate. After Wang Jiang Company obtained the land use right certificate for the 7,700.24 square meter plot 01-C in Haicang New District and the pre-sale permit for commercial housing for the Wang Jiang Garden (Phase I) project, it became the owner of the real estate of the Wang Jiang Garden (Phase I) project in accordance with law. Under the circumstance where Lei Yuancheng does not deny the legality of Wang Jiang Company's acquisition of the ownership certificates for the disputed real estate of the Wang Jiang Garden project, his claim that he is the actual owner of the disputed real estate does not conform to the principle of "one thing, one right" in real right confirmation, and this court does not support it. Article 184 of the "Company Law of the PRC" provides that if a company is dissolved due to the revocation of its business license, it shall establish a liquidation team within fifteen days from the date the cause for dissolution arises and commence liquidation. If a liquidation team is not established within the time limit to conduct liquidation, creditors may apply to the people's court to designate relevant personnel to form a liquidation team to conduct liquidation. The people's court shall accept such application and promptly organize a liquidation team to conduct liquidation. Article 33 of the "Regulations on the Administration of Registration of Enterprise Legal Persons of the PRC" provides: if an enterprise legal person's "Business License of Enterprise Legal Person" is revoked, its claims and debts shall be liquidated by the competent authority or a liquidation organization. The "Reply on How to Determine the Civil Litigation Status of an Enterprise After Its Business License is Revoked" by the Supreme People's Court and the "Reply on the Issue That the People's Court Should Not Rule to Dismiss a Lawsuit on the Grounds That a Party Company's Business License Has Been Revoked and It Has Lost Its Civil Litigation Subject Qualification" by the Economic Trial Division of the Supreme People's Court indicate that: after an enterprise's business license is revoked, it shall conduct liquidation in accordance with law. If the enterprise has not conducted liquidation, creditors may sue the enterprise's shareholders or the sponsoring entity to bear the responsibility for liquidation. According to the above legal provisions and with reference to the opinions in the Supreme People's Court's replies, after Wang Jiang Company's business license was revoked, liquidation proceedings should be initiated. Lei Yuancheng can confirm his rights and interests through the liquidation process, and upon confirmation, perform the corresponding obligations. If Wang Jiang Company and its shareholder Far East Real Estate Company fail to perform the liquidation obligations, Lei Yuancheng may apply to the people's court in accordance with law to form a liquidation team to conduct liquidation, or request a judgment ordering Wang Jiang Company and Far East Real Estate Company to bear the liquidation obligations. During the proceedings, Wang Jiang Company acknowledged all claims raised by Lei Yuancheng and agreed to confirm the ownership of the Wang Jiang Garden real estate to Lei Yuancheng. During the second instance of this court, Wang Jiang Company and Lei Yuancheng advocated mediation, and Wang Jiang Company agreed to confirm the ownership of the Wang Jiang Garden project to Lei Yuancheng. The above admissions and mediation proposals made by Wang Jiang Company during the proceedings constitute a disposition of the Wang Jiang Garden project real estate. Before initiating liquidation proceedings and confirming the rights and interests enjoyed by Lei Yuancheng, disposing of the company's major assets does not conform to the legal procedures for debt performance. If Wang Jiang Company has other debts, disposing of the company's major assets to Lei Yuancheng before liquidation would inevitably harm the interests of other creditors and violate the principle of fairness. Therefore, this court does not support the disposition of the company's assets by Wang Jiang Company through admissions or mediation.

In conclusion, the facts found in the first instance judgment are clear and the application of the law is correct. Pursuant to Article 153, Paragraph 1, Item (1) of the "Civil Procedure Law of the PRC," the judgment is as follows:

The appeal is dismissed and the original judgment is affirmed.

The second instance case acceptance fee of RMB 170,010 shall be borne by Lei Yuancheng.
This judgment is final.
